verdict.rationale: Workers supports event-driven automation through cron triggers and Queues integration. Event subscriptions publish structured account events (e.g., Worker build completed, R2 bucket created, Workers AI batch queued) to a queue, where Worker consumers can run custom logic. Durable Workflows can also pause for external events or approvals and retry automatically. The "rules" are written as code in consumers rather than set in a declarative rule builder. Missing for 10: a declarative or no-code way to define trigger rules and conditions, documented event filtering or matching semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automation.
